title: An Inner Watch-Den
summary: A warm, cramped den littered with thick wolf-pelts and hardened clay bowls. The floor vibrates with the shaman's drumming, and chalk markings cover the bedding wall.
inspect_text: Thick predator pelts line the floor, warm from recent bodies. The air is pungent with animal musk and hot grease. Scored into the stone behind the beds are chalk rings and tallies, identical in spacing to the marks on your own knuckles. The staff strikes stone nearby: tock… tock.

features.label: the bone pile
features.inspect_text: A collection of thick hide bundles and carved bone amulets, dusted with fine lime chalk.

title: A Curing Vault

inspect_text: Heavy, pungent smoke curls around drying frames loaded with salted venison and strips of hide. The center stone is stained black with resin and animal grease. Through the smoke, the rhythmic thud of the staff sounds directly through the opening: TOCK… TOCK.

features.label: the gutting stone
features.inspect_text: A massive dressing slab, dark and greasy, flanked by neat rows of flint wedges and bone carving chisels.

title: The Convergence of Tracks
summary: The patrolling channels deepen here, cut thick into stone and dusted with white chalk. They lead straight toward the central glow, and each strike of the shaman's staff vibrates hard through the floor.
inspect_text: All the tracks of the floor seem to gather here. Four deep channels converge at clean perpendiculars, their edges powdered white with stray chalk. The air is dry and hot against your face. Every few seconds, the floor shudders with a dull, heavy thump: TOCK. Something massive is striking stone just beyond.

features.label: the worn crossing tracks
features.inspect_text: Deep grooves converging like lines on a grid, whitened by chalk dust dragged in on small feet.

title: The Work-Ring
summary: The deepest chamber on this level. A wide circle of chalk glows on the cave floor — the same pale light as your own lines — and inside it, golems stand unfinished: a shoulder, a head with no seams yet, slabs of raw rock. The air is thick with ash and hot clay.
inspect_text: You stop at the edge of a wide chalk circle drawn on the cave floor, glowing the same pale light as the lines you draw yourself. Inside it, golems are being made: a shoulder of dark volcanic rock, a head still without seams, slabs of raw stone waiting to be given a shape. The air tastes of ash and hot clay and burned herbs. At the ring’s center the goblin shaman works, hunched and patient, one pale hand pressed flat to the stone. Tock. Tock. A staff beating slow time against the floor.

features.label: the chalk ring
features.inspect_text: A circle of chalk drawn on the cave floor, wide enough to stand in, glowing the pale color of your own marks. It is the largest of its kind you have seen.

descriptions.summary: The chalk ring lies scuffed and broken underfoot. The half-made golems stand unfinished, and there is no hand to finish them now. Only ash, and the cold smoke of an untended fire.
descriptions.inspect_text: The work-ring’s chalk is scuffed and broken under your feet. Half-made golems stand the way they were left — a shoulder, a seamless head, slabs of raw rock — and the dying fire twists one last thread of smoke at the room’s center. The air has gone still and cold.

inspect_text: The room stinks of old kill. Fire-scorch runs up the walls; a low flat stone in the middle is black and greasy with a thousand dressings; strips of meat hang from a frame, drying in the smoke. Flies buzz in a corner. Something here was living, and not long ago.

features.label: the gutting stone
features.inspect_text: A slab of rock worn black and smooth at its center, where the tribe dresses its kills. The smell is richest here.

title: The Convergence of Tracks
summary: The patrolling channels deepen here, cut thick into stone and dusted with white chalk. They lead straight toward the central glow, and each strike of the shaman's staff vibrates hard through the floor.
inspect_text: All the tracks of the floor seem to gather here. Four deep channels converge at clean perpendiculars, their edges powdered white with stray chalk. The air is dry and hot against your face. Every few seconds, the floor shudders with a dull, heavy thump: TOCK. Something massive is striking stone just beyond.

features.label: the worn crossing tracks
features.inspect_text: Deep grooves converging like lines on a grid, whitened by chalk dust dragged in on small feet.

title: A Glowing Crucible Chamber
summary: A wide pit of white-hot coals throbs with dry, baking heat. The stone walls are glazed red, and the air smells intensely of scorched clay and burned herbs.
inspect_text: Baking heat hits your chest like a wall. A wide stone trough glows with banked, white-hot embers that cast leaping shadows up the jagged ceiling. The air tastes bitter with chalk dust and burned mountain-sage. From the adjacent opening, the rhythm of the staff sounds close enough to touch: TOCK.

features.label: the ember pit
features.inspect_text: A heavy stone trough glowing white and cherry-red, radiating fierce heat that makes the air shimmer.

title: An Inner Watch-Den
summary: A warm, cramped den littered with thick wolf-pelts and hardened clay bowls. The floor vibrates with the shaman's drumming, and chalk markings cover the bedding wall.
inspect_text: Thick predator pelts line the floor, warm from recent bodies. The air is pungent with animal musk and hot grease. Scored into the stone behind the beds are chalk rings and tallies, identical in spacing to the marks on your own knuckles. The staff strikes stone nearby: tock… tock.

features.label: the bone pile
features.inspect_text: A collection of thick hide bundles and carved bone amulets, dusted with fine lime chalk.

title: A Cold Fire-Pit Chamber
summary: A low circle of blackened stones holds a bed of sluggish, dying embers. A cold draft from a chimney overhead flattens the smoke, and the room smells of damp soot and wet earth.
inspect_text: A circle of river stones surrounds a bed of embers struggling against a downdraft. The smoke is thin and cold, sucked toward a fissure in the rock above. You warm your hands a second above the faint orange glow; the heat barely cuts through the cave's chill.

features.label: the ember pit
features.inspect_text: Blackened river stones ringed around grey ash and dying orange coals. The stones are cold to the touch on their outer rim.

title: An Outer Den
summary: A low, drafty alcove where old pelts are piled against damp stone. The smell of cold musk and sour straw hangs in the air, and a small heap of gnawed bird-bones sits in the corner.
inspect_text: You have to stoop. The ceiling drops low over a scatter of moldering hides and stiff furs. A cold seep drips slowly down the back wall, plinking into a stone puddle. In the driest corner, small rodent bones lie arranged in neat little stacks of five—someone here counted them.

features.label: the bone pile
features.inspect_text: A small pile of dry, gnawed bones, sorted by size into neat little bundles.

title: A Scavenge Ground
summary: A cold cavern room littered with splintered bones and dried sinew. A low dressing rock sits under a chimney draft, smelling of old, dried blood and wet slate.
inspect_text: The air is cold and smells of dried sinew and stale blood. A flat limestone slab in the corner is gouged by rough flint scrapers, its surface stained dark. A draft pulls the smell away into high cracks, leaving the chamber stark and quiet.

features.label: the gutting stone
features.inspect_text: A flat limestone rock scarred by scraping blades, surrounded by dry shavings of antler and bone.

title: A Guarded Crossing
summary: A golem of dark volcanic rock, lumped and broad stands in the middle of the room, broad as a closed door, watching nothing. The floor around it is swept clean, and the air is the quietest on this level.
inspect_text: In the center of the room a golem of dark volcanic rock, lumped and broad stands still as furniture — no mouth, eyes of flat polished pebble, a pale chalk ring circling its chest and brow. It does not react to you. The room smells of cold stone and chalk dust, and small feet have kept clear of it for a long, long time.

features.label: the chalk-ring mark
features.inspect_text: A pale chalk ring is marked on the golem’s chest and brow, in the same pale light as the frost on the sleeping wall.

title: A Fire-Pit Chamber
summary: A shallow pit of embers glows in the middle of the floor, ringed with stones scored black by long use. Smoke layers flat against the ceiling like a low roof, and the room is warm enough to sweat in.
inspect_text: Heat meets you at the doorway. A shallow pit of embers throbs low in the center of the room, its ring of stones scarred by a thousand proddings with a fire-stick. The smoke hangs in a flat layer overhead, and your shadow stretches long across the floor. It smells of ash and old grease.

features.label: the ember pit
features.inspect_text: A ring of fire-scarred stones, and inside it embers that never quite die out. The coals breathe, orange and patient.

title: A Den
summary: A low-ceilinged den, thick with old hides and fur. A fire has burned down to ash against one wall, and gnawed bones are stacked neatly in a corner. The air is heavy with damp fur and musk.

features.label: the bone pile
features.inspect_text: A neat stack of long bones, gnawed clean and arranged almost carelessly — the way you’d tidy something you might want again.

title: The Mushroom Grove
summary: A cavern floor is choked with pale mushrooms, all leaning toward the glowing canopy above. The air smells of wet earth and something sweet, like crushed fruit.
inspect_text: Pale mushrooms crowd the floor, every cap leaning toward the glowing canopy above. The air holds wet earth and something sweet — crushed fruit, or a thing that ripened down here.

features.label: the pale mushrooms
features.inspect_text: Cluster after cluster of knee-high mushrooms sprout from the moist cave soil. Their pale spongy caps all lean uniformly toward the canopy above, as if turning toward a subterranean sun.

features.label: the glowing canopy
features.inspect_text: High above, living roots knit into an expansive vaulted ceiling woven with luminescent lichen and moss. A soft teal glow filters down through the gloom.

title: A Glowing Clearing
summary: A wide clearing lit by drifting spores that pulse slowly, like a heartbeat. Overhead a false sky shimmers, bright enough to read by, wrong enough to notice.
inspect_text: Spores drift across this clearing at a slow, even pulse, lighting the ground beneath your feet. Above, a false sky shimmers faintly — steady enough to read by, wrong enough that you notice.

features.label: the drifting spores
features.inspect_text: Glittering spores drift through the still air in lazy arcs, pulsing brighter and dimmer on an even, four-second cadence like a slow subterranean breath.

features.label: the false sky
features.inspect_text: The cavern ceiling shimmers like an artificial twilight sky. It offers just enough illumination to cast sharp shadows and reveal the path ahead.

title: The Root Tangle
summary: Great roots as thick as your arm weave through the walls here, and between them the forest breathes in and out. Somewhere at the edge of your hearing, something keeps time with it.
inspect_text: Great roots lace the walls and ceiling here, and between them the quiet forest breathes. You listen for a moment; somewhere in the dark, something answers on the same slow rhythm.

features.label: the root tangle
features.inspect_text: Gnarled roots as thick as your torso twist through cracks in the stone walls. They pulse with faint sap-warmth, flexing almost imperceptibly against the rock.

features.label: the living walls
features.inspect_text: Limestone blocks split by ancient wood. Cool water weeps down the fissures, feeding dense coats of dark moss.

title: A Still Pool Glade

features.label: the still pool

features.label: the ripples

title: The Fungus Hollow
summary: Across the hollow, mushrooms stand like sentinels, each near the height of your knee, planted in even ranks. Their caps throw pale light across the stone.
inspect_text: Pale light falls across the hollow from a hundred mushroom caps, each set evenly apart like a field that was planted on purpose. The light is cool and steady, good enough to see by.

features.label: the sentinel mushrooms
features.inspect_text: Stout mushrooms stand in orderly, grid-like rows across the damp earth. Their flat caps cast pale rings of light onto the soil like miniature lanterns.

features.label: the spore light
features.inspect_text: Cool phosphorescence emanating from beneath the mushroom gills, lighting up the soil in quiet pools.

title: A Chalked Trail
summary: Faint chalk lines run along the floor at your feet, worn almost to nothing, leading deeper into the dark. Someone drew a path here long ago and left it.
inspect_text: Thin chalk lines run ahead of you along the stone, worn to ghosts of their old marks. They keep to the center of the passage and lead deeper, as if someone once walked this way often.

features.label: the chalk trail
features.inspect_text: Thin white lines drawn with ancient mineral chalk trace the floor down the center of the lane. They have faded over decades of foot traffic, yet the geometry remains straight and deliberate.

features.label: the worn marks
features.inspect_text: Faint geometric intersections scored into the bedrock. Someone mapped this corridor with precision long before you walked it.

title: The Whispering Ferns
summary: Fern-like growths as tall as your shoulder line the walls, rustling though there is no wind. They whisper in a language that sounds almost familiar.
inspect_text: Tall fern-shaped growths line the walls on both sides, and they murmur without any wind to move them. The sound is almost language, almost your name, never quite either.

features.label: the whispering ferns
features.inspect_text: Towering fronds as tall as your shoulder rustle against each other in dry, rhythmic sibilance. In the rustling you catch fragments that sound uncannily like whispered syllables.

features.label: the rustling sound
features.inspect_text: The fronds move without wind, swaying in gentle synchrony with the breathing of the root-canopy.

title: A Shaft of Sky
summary: A crack in the cavern roof opens far above, and through it falls a light like starlight, pooling onto a bed of moss. You tilt your head back to watch it.
inspect_text: Far above, a crack in the roof lets in a column of pale light that pools on the moss by your feet. It is the first true light you have seen down here, and it is very old.

features.label: the shaft of sky
features.inspect_text: A sheer chimney cut into the vault far above. Through it falls a clean, vertical beam of silver starlight, cutting through the damp mist like a spear.

features.label: the moss bed
features.inspect_text: A thick velvet carpet of emerald moss thriving directly in the beam of starlight. It is cool and resilient beneath your boots.

summary: A crack in the cavern roof opens far above, and through it falls a light like starlight, pooling onto a bed of moss. You tilt your head back to watch it.
inspect_text: Far above, a crack in the roof lets in a column of pale light that pools on the moss by your feet. It is the first true light you have seen down here, and it is very old.

features.label: the shaft of sky
features.inspect_text: A sheer chimney cut into the vault far above. Through it falls a clean, vertical beam of silver starlight, cutting through the damp mist like a spear.

features.label: the moss bed
features.inspect_text: A thick velvet carpet of emerald moss thriving directly in the beam of starlight. It is cool and resilient beneath your boots.

title: The Deep Glade
summary: The air here is still and old, and the hum of this forest is loudest at your back. Glowing vines hang around you like curtains, their light slow and steady.
inspect_text: Still, old air lines this glade, and the forest hum is loudest here. Curtains of glowing vine hang heavy around you, their light riding the same slow pulse as the spores of the outer woods.

features.label: the glowing vines
features.inspect_text: Thick curtains of braided vine hang from the boughs like tapestries. Their pale teal veins throb in time with the forest's deep pulse.

features.label: the forest hum
features.inspect_text: A low vibration that thrums in your teeth and chest. The deep roots of the back rank anchor the entire cavern.

title: The King's Grove
summary: The forest parts into a wide, still chamber. At its heart, enthroned in roots and pale light, sits the elf king, watching the entrance — watching you.
inspect_text: The trees open at last into a wide, still chamber. In a throne woven of roots and pale light sits the elf king, and he is looking at the entrance, at you, with no hurry at all.

features.label: the root throne
features.inspect_text: A grand seat grown seamlessly out of living ash-grey roots and curled bark. Ancient carvings mark its high backrest, worn smooth by centuries of royal repose.

features.label: the pale light
features.inspect_text: A concentrated corona of silver-green illumination bathing the center of the grove, undisturbed by drafts or smoke.

descriptions.summary: The forest opens into a wide, still chamber. Where the elf king once sat enthroned in roots and pale light, only a hollowed throne of grey bark remains.

title: The North Offering
summary: A great dish of black glass stands against the north wall like an open mouth, gathering the ring that circles the board toward it.
inspect_text: The store of the board: where the gathered stones were poured and counted. The glass around it is cool, but you know the heat this room was made to hold.

features.label: the fire-bowl
features.inspect_text: A wide dish of black glass, deep as a man's chest. Its lip is scored where embers have been poured in and cleared away a thousand times.

features.label: the black glass
features.inspect_text: Sheets of polished volcanic glass form the foundation of the north store, cool and slick beneath your boots.

title: The South Store
summary: The ring bends south into a second dish, shallower than the first, and at its bottom a single ember smoulders.
inspect_text: The far store of the board. One seed has been left behind — warm, steady, waiting for a hand to move it.

features.label: the fire-bowl
features.inspect_text: A wide dish of black glass. A single ember smoulders at its bottom, the last seed of the south store.

features.label: the banked ember
features.inspect_text: A stubborn node of cherry-red heat pulsing softly in the soot of the south store.

title: A Basin of Cooling Embers
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. In its center a broad depression holds one red coal that never quite dies.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. A single coal breathes in the depression, skirted by black glass. It does not warm the room — only the memory of warmth.

features.label: the glass basin
features.inspect_text: A single coal breathes in the depression, skirted by black glass. It does not warm the room — only the memory of warmth.

features.label: the thermal cracks
features.inspect_text: Hairline fractures spiderweb through the black glass floor, radiating dull warmth from heat chambers below.

summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. A film of embers lies over the glass, caught like seeds before sowing.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. Tiny embers fleck the floor like a scatter of seed, slightly warmer under the fingers than the surrounding glass.

inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. Two scored lines run out of this chamber and vanish around the curve of the ring.

summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. A dull warmth rises through the floor, here at the board's one true hearth.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. Heat wells up gently through the seams. Beneath, you sense the same dead fire you have felt all along: banked, waiting.

inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. The floor is glass worn mirror-smooth, the recorded arc of a thousand unseen moves.

title: The Heart-Pit
summary: The ring's center opens into a shallow pit of black glass, and in it, on a cradle of embers, a fire burns — patient, watchful, alone.
inspect_text: The ring's center opens into a shallow pit of black glass. In the cradle, a clot of embers holds to a deep, steady heat. Something in it watches the edge of the pit.

features.label: the coals
features.inspect_text: In the cradle of the pit, a clot of embers burns with a deep, steady heat. It does not crackle. It does not spread. It simply holds.

features.label: the obsidian cradle
features.inspect_text: A sunken saucer of seamless black glass engineered to concentrate the cavern's elemental heat at its center.

descriptions.summary: The heart-pit is empty. Where the Fire Elemental burned, only a round cradle of black glass remains, still warm, holding a faint spiral of ash.

title: North Approach Plaza
summary: A broad paved plaza at the northern apex of the village. Ahead, the massive iron-and-brass bulkhead of the military fortress looms over the road, sealed shut. Two heavily-armed garrison guards stand sentry before the reinforced gates.
inspect_text: Steam pipes run along high stone pylons to heat the open plaza. Two stern garrison sentries stand watch before the sealed brass bulkhead with ready steam crossbows, permitting no one to pass.

features.label: the massive brass bulkhead
features.inspect_text: A towering bulkhead of banded iron and riveted brass, bolted firmly from within. There is no exterior handle, and the sentries ensure nobody approaches.

title: Clockmaker's Workshop
summary: A stone terrace and open workshop lined with brass fittings. The air clicks and hums with miniature clockwork gears and steam escapements.
inspect_text: Tariq's clockwork workshop overlooks the cavern descent. Glass cabinets house brass calipers, gear trains, and intricate timing mechanisms.

features.label: the clockwork workbench
features.inspect_text: A sturdy wooden workbench covered in jeweler's loupes, brass cogwheels, fine tweezers, and sketches of intricate escapements.

title: Wash Basin Terrace
summary: A communal stone terrace lined with laundry tubs fed by warm condensed-water pipes from the central boiler.
inspect_text: Lines of heavy canvas work-shirts and overalls hang drying in warm air rising from floor grates. Clear, warm water drains into low limestone gutters. A heavy iron pressure valve is mounted beside the main steam riser.

features.label: communal washing trough
features.inspect_text: A long zinc-lined stone trough filled with warm steaming water, scrubbed clean by generations of miners' families.

features.label: the steam pressure valve
features.inspect_text: A heavy cast-iron wheel mounted to a high-pressure brass junction. It vents steam directly from the central boiler lines into an exhaust flue. Turning it would release line pressure with a deafening roar.

title: Water Spring Terrace
summary: A tranquil corner where cold subterranean springs bubble from living rock into tiered stone basins.
inspect_text: Villagers fill brass canteens and wooden buckets. Overhead copper pipes radiate gentle warmth to keep the damp terrace comfortable.

features.label: the natural stone fountain
features.inspect_text: A natural moss-edged hollow in limestone overflowing with cold, clear drinking water.

title: The Village Square
summary: The beating heart of the village. A broad circular plaza paved in concentric stone rings, illuminated by warm gas lamps.
inspect_text: At the center, broad spiral stone stairs lead UP to the Floor 3 Heart-Pit ('oh'). A large iron hearth warms the gathering villagers.

features.label: the central stone stairs
features.inspect_text: Solid granite stairs ascending into the dark ceiling toward Floor 3.

title: Elder Rashid's Quarters
summary: A modest stone building lined with bookshelves, maps of the cavern system, and brass surveying instruments.
inspect_text: Elder Rashid sits here at a heavy oak desk, head in his hands, surrounded by official military decrees and the requisition roll for Zayd.

features.label: the requisition roll
features.inspect_text: A parchment document bearing Captain Malik's iron seal, demanding one youth as an offering.

title: South Overlook Terrace
summary: A high stone parapet at the southeastern tip of the village, looking down into the deep subterranean abyss.
inspect_text: A low stone wall keeps children safe from the drop. Lanterns flicker along the railing, casting long shadows into the cavern vastness.

features.label: parapet overlook wall
features.inspect_text: Solid limestone blocks cut with drainage scuppers, polished smooth by generations of leaning villagers.

title: Yasmin's Bakery
summary: A warm, flour-dusted bakery smelling wonderfully of fresh flatbread, sesame, and roasted dates.
inspect_text: A huge brick oven heated by copper steam coils dominates the back. Yasmin stands by the counter, tearful and furious over Zayd's capture.

features.label: the steam-heated oven
features.inspect_text: A massive domed brick hearth with steam pipes wrapping its base, baking scores of flatbreads.

title: North Terrace Gardens
summary: Tiered planter boxes cut from the cavern floor, glowing with phosphorescent green and blue lichen.
inspect_text: Carefully tended moisture trays nurture edible mushrooms and small sweet subterranean root vegetables.

features.label: phosphorescent planter boxes
features.inspect_text: Carved limestone planters filled with rich compost and glowing moss providing soft blue illumination.

title: Fortress Checkpoint
summary: The main entry checkpoint just inside the massive brass bulkhead. High iron barricades, coiled wire, and sentry platforms overlook the passage. Red emergency lamps cast long shadows across the steel floor.
inspect_text: A fortified staging area designed to control movement between the village and the military fortress. Steam conduits hiss against the reinforced stone ceiling. A heavy hydraulic lever mounted to the wall controls the locking pins on the outer bulkhead.

features.label: the hydraulic gate lever
features.inspect_text: A heavy brass lever set into an iron console. Pulling it cycles the steam rams that lock and unlock the outer bulkhead.

title: West Iron Walkway
summary: A narrow, damp iron catwalk bolted to the dark cavern wall. Hissing copper steam pipes run overhead, dripping hot water into the shadowy drop below. The metal mesh floor trembles underfoot.
inspect_text: Cold air mixes with warm steam rising from deep rock cracks below. The walkway provides a direct route along the western flank of the military complex toward the detention wing.

features.label: overhead steam pipes
features.inspect_text: Thick copper and iron pipes clamped to the cavern rock with heavy steel brackets. Steam wheezes rhythmically through sealed joints.

title: Suspended Steam Cage
summary: A reinforced iron cage hanging from heavy ceiling chains over a hissing geothermal fissure. An iron walkway rings the pit, guarded by a locked winch console.
inspect_text: The iron bars are black with soot and hot to the touch from the thermal draft below. Heavy steel cables run from the cage roof to a mechanical winch bolted into the granite floor.

features.label: the suspended iron cage
features.inspect_text: A sturdy iron-barred cage suspended ten feet out over the steam pit. A heavy brass padlock secures the cage gate, cut to fit the warden's iron key.

title: South Steam Gantry
summary: A low, sweltering maintenance corridor threading between massive steam boiler pipes and humming power dynamos. Dense white vapor billows from floor grates.
inspect_text: The heat is intense and smells of hot machine oil and warm stone. Pressure gauges vibrate in the brass housings lining the wall, regulating the power flow to the central platform.

features.label: brass pressure gauges
features.inspect_text: A bank of round glass-faced gauges with vibrating needles. They monitor steam pressure flowing between the southern boilers and the central courtyard.

title: Commander's Bastion
summary: The fortified headquarters of Captain Malik. A large brass tactical table dominates the center of the room, surrounded by patrol routes and subterranean maps. An iron combination safe is embedded in the stone wall.
inspect_text: Neat weapon racks and polished armor stands line the walls. Red silk military banners hang between steam vents. A heavy steel safe with dual combination tumblers stands bolted into the granite.

features.label: the commander's iron safe
features.inspect_text: A heavy iron safe with brass combination dials and reinforced hinges, embedded into the granite wall. It is locked tight by dual tumbler deadbolts, requiring Commander Malik's key to open.

title: East Sentry Rampart
summary: A wide, steel-plated rampart running along the eastern face of the fortress. Brass searchlight housings sit mounted on iron tripods, aimed into the open central courtyard.
inspect_text: Spent crossbow bolts and discarded ration tins lie near the guard benches. The vantage point offers a clear view through the security grilles into the glowing platform in the center courtyard.

features.label: brass searchlight mount
features.inspect_text: A directional brass searchlight powered by a heavy steam conduit battery. Its reflector lens is angled downward toward the courtyard below.

title: Teleportation Platform
summary: A sunken circular courtyard of dark basalt. At its center rises a massive circular brass platform etched with geometric circuits, pulsing with pale turquoise light from deep geothermal conduits.
inspect_text: Thick copper energy lines converge on the central brass ring. Steam releases in rhythmic pulses from surrounding relief valves. Tracing the Teleportation Sigil here will activate the descent gate to Floor 5.

features.label: the circular brass teleport platform
features.inspect_text: An ancient brass disc inscribed with intersecting double triangles. The central circle hums with arcane and geothermal power, waiting for the matching chalk sigil.

title: Floor 5 Descent Platform
summary: A deep subterranean vault where warm mist curls off ancient flagstones. A matching brass teleport circle hums quietly here, anchoring the transit line from Floor 4.
inspect_text: The brass dais beneath your boots remains warm from the transit pulse. Ancient archways open into the forgotten depths of the fifth floor.

features.label: the descent platform
features.inspect_text: A brass transport platform anchored into the stone bedrock. It hums with stable transit energy connecting back to Floor 4.
